notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes show Pueblo County Fair outreach and Cody Shue. She spoke with Cody in May 2026 and information was sent. Earlier notes also list Cody's work cell 719-248-0367. Adventure Zone Gmail confirms a 2027-oriented follow-up after that conversation. Source: handwritten call notes pages 82/123; Adventure Zone Gmail.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: Cody requested information during 2026 outreach and the conversation shifted to 2027 because Adventure Zone was already booked for the 2026 dates.
